Package com.cooke.shapes

package com.cooke.shapes
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    App
    Main loop Class CLI shape builder application; user will be presented with a menu of shapes to choose from, then user will be prompted to specify the size parameters of the shape; these parameters will change for each shape; the user will then be shown the calculated area of the shape if it is a 2D shape, or the volume of the shape if it is 3D.
    Circle
    Circle Class Creates a Circle object with with a radius; The circle's area is calculated when a new circle is created and when the radius is adjusted.
    Cone
    Cone Class Creates a Cone object with with a radius and a height; The Cone's volume is calculated when a new Cone is created and when the radius or height is adjusted.
    Cube
    Cube Class Creates a Cube object with with a given length; The Cube's volume is calculated when a new Cube is created and when the radius is adjusted.
    Cylinder
    Cylinder Class Creates a Cylinder object with with a radius and a height; The Cylinder's volume is calculated when a new Cylinder is created and when the radius or height is adjusted.
    Rectangle
    Rectangle Class Creates a Rectangle object with a length and a width; The rectangle's area is calculated when a new rectantgle is created and when either side length is adjusted.
    Shape
    Abstract Shape Class Provides common fields and methods that apply to all shapes.
    Sphere
    Sphere Class Creates a Sphere object with with a radius; The sphere's volume is calculated when a new sphere is created and when the radius is adjusted.
    Square
    Square Class Creates a Square object with four sides of equal length; The square's area is calculated when a new square is created and when the side length is adjusted.
    ThreeDimensionalShape
    Abstract ThreeDimensionalShape Class Provides common fields and methods that apply to three-dimensional shapes (cube, sphere, etc).
    Torus
    Torus Class Creates a Torus object with with a major radius and a minor radius; The Torus's volume is calculated when a new Torus is created and when the major radius or minor radius is adjusted.
    Triangle
    Triangle Class and TriangleType enum class Creates a Triangle object with three sides of adjustable lentgth; The triangle area and triangle type is calculate when a new triangle is created and when any side is adjusted.
    TwoDimensionalShape
    Abstract TwoDimensionalShape Class Provides common fields and methods that apply to two-dimensional shapes (square, rectangle, etc).
